conversation_starters.title: Minneapolis scooter takeover: Scooters and bikes ride onto I-35W, around downtown
conversation_starters.summary: Hundreds of scooters rode onto I-35W, the interstate that runs north–south through the middle of Minneapolis, on Saturday night as part of an apparent takeover in downtown Minneapolis.
questions: Did the scooter takeover affect your commute at all?

conversation_starters.title: Continental U.S.'s largest women-only triathlon returns to Minneapolis
conversation_starters.summary: The largest women-only triathlon in the continental U.S. returned to Lake Nokomis, a lake in south Minneapolis, on Sunday.

conversation_starters.summary: The annual Uptown Porchfest returns on August 15, turning porches in Uptown — a Minneapolis neighborhood just southwest of downtown — into stages for over 85 bands.

you_should_know.title: After Pig's Eye closure, St. Paul encampment doubles in size near luxury apartments
you_should_know.summary: The closure of the Pig's Eye Park encampment in St. Paul — the neighboring city just east of Minneapolis — prompted dozens of people living there to take up residence at a different city encampment some seven miles up the Mississippi River.
